note: Built from the Forgejo fork's main at f9844e9, the archive of the fork's standalone 1.1.0: the source of 9405a49 (0.10.4's archive, below) plus 97ca947 (the swapchain texture table holds at most three pointers, and the overlay draws only after a successful acquire with an index inside it) and c27ab7e (L3 + R3 toggles ImGui gamepad navigation only when imgui_smash_set_gamepad_nav_toggle(true) was called; Deluxe does not call it, so the chord no longer turns navigation on in Deluxe's window). 9405a49 was made on the fork's sparse-codepoint-index branch (unicode-shared-font plus a paged per-codepoint glyph index: the fork's CMake applies imgui-smash/patches/imgui/0001-paged-codepoint-index.patch to a copy of the Dear ImGui submodule; imgui_smash_font_use_paged_index, called by Deluxe before imgui_smash_init, keeps the overlay fonts' index in 256-codepoint pages where glyphs exist; font stats version 3). unicode-shared-font: the NVN backend honours ImGui's texture requests; the system shared fonts are merged after JetBrains Mono's ASCII subset; a static set of ASCII, Latin-1 Supplement and Latin Extended-A is rasterized once, and the dynamic set holds only the other characters on screen, dropped between frames once they leave it; Alpha8 atlas 512x128 growing to at most 1024x1024. Two clean builds with the fork's Build-Standalone.ps1 -Action archive and one with this repository's prepare_imgui.py commands (a clone of the pinned commit; rootless Podman in place of Docker) produced this archive byte for byte.
